_meta.source: Best-of merge: Claude analysis (primary) + Gemini analysis (cherry-picked improvements)
_meta.canvas: 600x600px square, origin top-left, coordinates in percent

roles.hero: Large focal flowers (rose, peony, dahlia, magnolia, hydrangea) — 20-25% canvas width
roles.accent: Tall/wispy flowers (gladiolus, delphinium, snapdragon, wisteria) — need vertical clearance above greenery
roles.filler: Small/round flowers (daisy, buttercup, cosmos, anemone, coreopsis) — 10-15% canvas width
roles.avoid: Dense/busy zones where flowers clash visually with the greenery

bg_1.notes: V-shaped foliage fan. Dense stem-crossing zone at center y:40–48 — primary avoid. Mid-foliage shelf at y:50–58 is the natural hero pocket. Accent tips extend well above the V arms. Lower outer corners taper nicely for fillers.

bg_2.notes: Wide-spread pointed-leaf bouquet. Supports an asymmetric hero trio (Gemini insight merged). Long arching stems create open negative space at upper corners for tall accents. Avoid the crossing zone around y:38–48.

bg_3.notes: Compact circular bouquet (seeded eucalyptus). Very dense core from y:30–50. Third hero at y:65 (Gemini insight) works below the mass where stems thin out. Outer ring of bouquet is the main flower zone.

bg_4.notes: Symmetrical fan/myrtle shape with thin wispy branches. Less dense than round bouquets so avoid zone is smaller. Accents placed wide follow the outer branch lines naturally. Strong symmetric three-hero placement works well.

bg_5.notes: Spiky outward-spreading branches. Wide horizontal reach. Upper corners are relatively open — good for accents that extend above the silhouette. Gemini's avoid at (10,10) and (90,10) discarded — those are genuinely empty canvas and flowers there would float disconnected.

baby_blue_eucalyptus.notes: Tall upright spray with dense round orb clusters throughout central column. The round berries create strong visual noise — heroes should sit just below the densest cluster band (y:50–60). Filler moved lower (y:65–75) vs Gemini's y:35 which clashes with orb texture.

english_ivy.notes: Radial starburst of star-shaped ivy leaves. Lacy texture overall allows some hero overlap with foliage. Keep outermost trailing leaf tips uncovered (Gemini insight) — accent placements kept closer to center to preserve visible ivy outline. Filler at lower outer positions.

maidenhair_fern.notes: Delicate airy fronds in wide upward V. Transparent enough that flowers layer forgivingly. Third hero at (60,45) from Gemini is a good addition — maidenhair's lighter texture supports it. Accent tips at y:15–25 extend well above the frond tips. Keep central stem zone clear.

monstera_leaves.notes: Large dramatic monstera leaves. Heroes placed above center (y:38–45) on leaf surfaces — the large leaf planes act as natural backdrops. Merged Gemini's outer-lower avoid zones (20,60) and (80,60) — those outer leaf-edge areas look unnatural with overlaid flowers. Avoid zones expanded to 5 total.

olive_branches.notes: Classic upward-arching olive branches. Narrow leaves make this one of the least dense — only 2 avoid zones needed at the lower stem bundle. Excellent for classic wedding bouquet composition. Three-hero arrangement perfectly follows the V arch. Accents extend high above branch tips.

ruscus_branches.notes: Dense flat-leaf ruscus in wide fan. Medium-sized overlapping leaves create a clear density gradient — dense core, sparse tips. Outer reaching branches provide natural channels for tall accents. Three-hero trio at the central foliage shelf works well. Avoid the heavy overlap zone at lower-center.

silver_dollar_eucalyptus.notes: Round silver-dollar leaves on arching stems. Larger, more widely-spaced coins than baby_blue — slightly less dense so a third hero point added. Still avoid the central vertical stem column. Large coin leaves make a strong visual backdrop for bold hero flowers like peonies.

sword_fern.notes: Wide starburst of horizontal sword fern fronds radiating from central crown. Gemini correctly noted the primary hero should sit lower at y:65 where the frond base fans wide — merged as first hero. Additional heroes between frond lines at upper positions. Place flowers between frond spokes, not on top of them. Avoid the tight center crown entirely.
